name: LogiFlow AI
description: A personal project exploring AI infrastructure, service templates, and cloud-native automation. The listed capabilities describe the project direction; production deployment is not claimed.

features.title: AI Gateway
features.detail: Exploration area: provider-neutral routing, semantic caching, prompt versioning, cost controls, rate limiting, and circuit breakers.

features.title: MCP Server Integration
features.detail: Exploration area: safe tool exposure and agent interoperability using Model Context Protocol concepts.

features.title: Multi-Agent Workflow Engine
features.detail: Design direction: durable execution, approval steps, long-running workflows, retries, and compensation patterns.

features.title: RAG Platform
features.detail: Design direction: document ingestion, vector indexing, hybrid search, and context assembly.

features.title: Kubernetes Operator
features.detail: Design direction: tenant provisioning, namespaces, resource quotas, network policies, and workload isolation.

name: LogiSynapse
description: A personal logistics SaaS and distributed systems project for exploring service boundaries, event-driven workflows, and API design. Production scale or deployment is not claimed.

features.title: Shipment Service
features.detail: Design scope: a Go service with gRPC APIs, PostgreSQL persistence, and event-driven boundaries.

features.title: Route Engine & ETA Predictor
features.detail: Design scope: routing and ETA workflows with room for later machine-learning integration.

features.title: Workflow Orchestrator
features.detail: Design scope: durable orchestration, retries, and fallback handling for logistics workflows.

features.title: Real-Time Notifications
features.detail: Design scope: messaging and WebSocket delivery for shipment updates.

features.title: GraphQL Gateway
features.detail: Design scope: a GraphQL entry point coordinating service APIs and internal RPC calls.

name: Enterprise Authentication Platform
description: A personal authentication platform concept exploring OAuth2, identity, tenant isolation, and auditability. Capabilities are project goals and are not presented as a production service.

features.title: Identity & OIDC Server
features.detail: Exploration area: OAuth2 and OpenID Connect flows for identity and federation.

features.title: Multi-Tenant Isolation
features.detail: Exploration area: tenant isolation, role-based authorization, and user authentication.

features.title: MFA & API Key Management
features.detail: Exploration area: multi-factor authentication and scoped API key lifecycle management.

features.title: Security & Auditing
features.detail: Exploration area: session controls and auditable security events.
